# #[ignore]d tests the rust_test job in .github/workflows/sami-rust-test.yml runs
# anyway: each alone, after the other tests, with `--ignored --exact <name>`
# and a 1200 s bound for that one run. The job fails unless each runs there
# (exactly that test, not still ignored), and when it fails, like any test.
# A target is a Bazel one (//...), or a cargo one as the test step labels it,
# <directory>:<kind>:<name> (a cargo workspace in rust-test-cargo-workspaces.txt).
# A Bazel one whose why starts `opt: ` runs in a -c opt build of its target,
# after every other Bazel invocation; the job log gives its build and test
# seconds.
# One per line: <target> <libtest test name>  <why it is #[ignore]d>.
//crates/pi-ast:pi-ast_test block::tests::pruned_walk_matches_unpruned_on_full_repo_corpus  opt: a sweep of the whole repository (PI_AST_REPO_CORPUS); upstream runs it by hand in release builds, and in fastbuild it took 1,033.6 s of run 45516812533
//crates/pi-natives:pi_natives_test pty::zombie_repro_tests::cancelled_pty_sessions_do_not_leak_zombies  a storm of cancelled pty sessions that counts the test process's zombies, so no other test's children may be counted
//crates/pi-vcs:pi-vcs_integration_tests_tests/worktree_add_failure_test an_add_into_an_empty_directory_someone_else_owns_succeeds  needs an empty directory another user owns that the test user can write: the job makes one as root (PI_VCS_TEST_FOREIGN_EMPTY_DIR)
//crates/pi-vcs:pi-vcs_test git::mutate::tests::reclaim_refuses_a_tree_holding_a_mount_point  needs a mount point inside a directory the test user owns: the job mounts a tmpfs there as root (PI_VCS_TEST_MOUNT_POINT)
//crates/pi-vcs:pi-vcs_test git::mutate::tests::reclaim_refuses_a_tree_holding_a_mounted_file  needs a file bind-mounted inside a directory the test user owns: the job mounts one as root (PI_VCS_TEST_MOUNTED_FILE)
sdk/rust/omp-rpc:test:smoke smoke_get_tree_deep_chain  runs the repository's tree RPC fixture (bun packages/coding-agent/test/fixtures/tree-rpc-agent.ts, with a mock model) over a session of 100,000 chained entries, which needs bun, the dependencies and the native addon
sdk/rust/omp-rpc:test:smoke smoke_real_server  runs the repository's omp server (bun packages/coding-agent/src/cli.ts --mode rpc), which needs bun, the dependencies and the native addon
sdk/rust/omp-rpc:test:smoke smoke_scripted_model  runs the omp server against the scripted model server (packages/coding-agent/test/rpc-wire/fake-openai-server.ts)
